_note: The perf win log: one entry per measured win, newest first. PERF-LOG.md is generated from this file (`node scripts/perf-log.mjs --write`); tests/perf-log.test.mjs fails when it is stale or an entry is missing a measured before and after, a unit, how it was measured, a test or a PR.

wins.win: The home page's layers story no longer shifts the layout as it opens (#123)
wins.metric: CLS of the home page over a full layers cycle (index#layers), Chromium
wins.how: PerformanceObserver layout-shift entries (sources: the slider knob and the rail squares, now moved by translate); pixel diff at 1440 and 390 unchanged at rest
wins.test: tests/layers.mjs (fails on any layout shift over a full cycle)

wins.win: The Battlefield landing hero runs at 30 fps instead of every vsync
wins.metric: main thread busy, battlefield.domvirus.com hero, 390 × 844 phone at 4× CPU, seconds 6–11 after load, median of 3 (hero-less page 0.5 %)
wins.how: Chromium, CPU throttle, interleaved with the hero-less page; load avg 5.5 → 3.2 (a second run: 88.4 → 53.5 %)
wins.test: dom-battlefield tests/site.mjs (hero frame cap (phone): ≤ 33 rAF/s battling, 0 once settled)

wins.win: The fps cap counts its slot from the frame's start, so a slow frame still meets its next slot
wins.metric: rAF/s of the battlefield.domvirus.com hero (fps: 30), 390 × 844 phone at 4× CPU, seconds 6–11 after load, median of 3 (asked for 30)
wins.how: Chromium, CPU throttle, page-wide rAF count; vendored 0.19.0 vs fizlet main's engine.ts with the fix, same run, load avg 2.3–3.4
wins.test: tests/kernel.test.mjs (a slow frame still meets its next slot: 20 ms frames at fps 30, 20 → 30 fps)

wins.win: presence's WebSocket transport allocates nothing per message
wins.metric: young-generation GCs over 400k WebSocket sends (Node 24, fake socket, best of 3)
wins.how: node --expose-gc, scavenges counted around the send loop

wins.win: fizlet.com serves its two stylesheets minified
wins.metric: gzip bytes of board-ui.css + site.css, loaded by every fizlet.com page (8,301 → 4,884 and 11,530 → 9,091)
wins.how: zlib gzip of site-dist before and after (−5,856 B on every first visit); screenshots of every page compared
wins.test: tests/site.mjs (the served stylesheets are minified and smaller than their sources)

wins.win: The fps cap caps requestAnimationFrame, not just the work
wins.metric: page-wide rAF calls a second while fizz#hero is in view, home page at 1440 (two 30 fps heroes)
wins.how: real-browser audit (Chromium, abe browse, page-wide rAF count)
wins.test: tests/kernel.test.mjs (rAF calls a second at 60 and 120 Hz), tests/site.mjs (fizz story page-wide rAF ≤ 33/s)

wins.win: The home demo settles when nothing moves
wins.metric: page-wide rAF calls a second while the demo is in view and untouched, /gallery/ at 1440 (60.3 → 0 at 390)
wins.how: real-browser audit (Chromium, abe browse); it settles half a second after the last letter, wave, particle and scorch mark stop
wins.test: tests/site.mjs (settled: no frames while nothing moves)
